numericSummary.interpretation: Sign test targets Pr(d>0 | d!=0)=0.5, not E[d]=0. Bootstrap is conditional on fixed training models and the observed test-group empirical distribution; ordinary unstratified resampling allows quality counts to vary and does not represent original quality-stratified design uncertainty, training or split variability.

findings.detail: Compares delta-MSE confidence interval to 0.03 squared despite threshold being defined on delta-RMSE; describes bootstrap as re-drawing splits and claims robustness to bootstrap-method choice without doing it.
Claims any reasonable reading makes benefit negligible and MAE difference has no operational significance, exceeding the unvalidated operational threshold and missing domain utility evidence.
Full-row sensitivity reweights only held-out rows with fixed deduplicated-training fits; cannot establish insensitivity to deduplication choice.

Initial task explicitly requested record/report/study correspondence, inclusion/exclusion reasons, and future precision/detectable-effect/repetition planning. Current report gives counts/background only and no planning.
Unstratified record-group bootstrap changes quality stratum counts in resamples; claim that quality composition is unchanged is false. Fixed input empirical distribution is not fixed resample counts.

A confidence interval crossing zero does not diagnose inadequate precision/sample size/power; here the stated half-width is much smaller than the report own approximate threshold scale. Remove low-precision/insufficiency causal claim and unvalidated effect-scale planning inference; retain outcome and future planning gaps.
Negative quadratic coefficient means concave downward; parenthesis about upward curvature decreasing is unclear.
